name: htex-editor-bundle
description: HyperTeX 뷰어의 원문 편집기 (CodeMirror 6) 를 htex/viewer/editor.js 하나로 묶는다. npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=chrome108 --legal-comments=none "--banner:js=/* HyperTeX editor: CodeMirror 6 (MIT) bundle. Licenses in editor.LICENSE.txt. Source: tools/editor (npm ci && npm run build) */" --metafile=meta.json --outfile=../../htex/viewer/editor.js && node licenses.js
